parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

> If you set this parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the `NodeId` parameter.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

>

- The end time must be later than the start time.

- The end time must be within 24 hours from the start time. Otherwise, the query fails.

parameters.name: LogicalOperator
parameters.description:
The logical relationship among multiple keywords.

- **or**

- **and** (default value)

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The ID of the shard node.

> This parameter is required only when you specify the `DBInstanceId` parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance.

parameters.name: OrderType
parameters.description:
The order of time in which the log entries to return are sorted. Valid values:

- asc: The log entries are sorted by time in ascending order.

- desc: The log entries are sorted by time in descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the INTEGER data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **30** to **100**.

parameters.name: QueryKeywords
parameters.description: The keywords used for query. You can enter up to 10 keywords at a time. If you enter multiple keywords, separate the keywords with spaces.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instances you want to query belong.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-slow-log-records --db-instance-id dds-bp1fc7e651080000 --node-id d-bp18b06ebc210000 --start-time 2021-08-15T14:13Z --end-time 2021-08-16T14:13Z --db-name mongodbtest --query-keywords test_test1 --logical-operator and --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --order-type asc --resource-group-id rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000 --region cn-hangzhou
